items.title: 67260_Freddie Moore oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...Was Teddy Bunn with the band then? Did he join the band? [INTERVIEWEE] That would have to be... [INTERVIEWER] That was later. [INTERVIEWEE] After we left.

ctx.x: Well, who was your guitar player at that time? Or was there a guitar at that time? Was Teddy Bunn with the band then? Did he join the band?
